title: Search-Informed MPPI for Kinodynamic Motion Planning via Monte Carlo Tree Expansion
description:
arXiv:2611.26763v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Kinodynamic motion planning in large-scale, cluttered environments remains challenging, as dynamically feasible, collision-free trajectories must be computed efficiently over long horizons.
